rules:
(v1, 2026-10-21)
- Every published rung spawns ONE hypothetical perp trade the first time price touches it after it was armed
  (armed = valid_from of the label publication that carried it; disarmed when a later publication drops it, unless
  already triggered). Longs at Consider adding / Add on dip / Deep value; shorts at Getting warm / Take profit.
- Entry: the rung price on touch (if the bar opens through the rung, fill at that bar's open).
- Stop: just beyond (0.5%) the next rung on the same side (Consider adding -> Deep value; Getting warm -> Take profit);
  for the outer rung (or if none) the next stronger (W/M) S/R level beyond it; fallback 10% away. Setups: their stop
  (invalidation).
- Target: the next opposite-side level. Add/warm rungs -> first resistance above / support below the publication's
  ref price (the "Neutral" band edge); Deep value -> the Consider adding rung; Take profit -> the Getting warm rung.
  Setups: their first target. Fallback 10%.
- Max hold 10 days (240 h), then exit at close. Stop and target in the same bar = stop (conservative). On the entry bar
  only a stop counts, or a target if the bar CLOSES beyond it.
- No leverage. Score in R multiples ((exit-entry)/|entry-stop|, sign-adjusted) and % move, net of 0.05% fee per side.
- Context tags: coin, rung, side, level tf (M/W/D), RSI d/w at entry, divergences, whether the RSI shift moved the rung,
  offset_pct, strategy. Strategies (scored separately, same rules): ladder_off0/0.5/1 (front-run offset x ATR14),
  scaled_ladder (half at add, half at deep, common stop beyond deep), rsi_reclaim (daily RSI closes back above 30 within 3%
  of W/M support -> long next open; short mirror at 70), div_confirm (Regular 1d/1w divergence confirmed on the close ->
  next open, stop beyond the pivot), breakout_retest (retest of a W/M resistance broken by a daily close, within 10d).
  Forward for strategies = same daily engine replayed on bars from Oct 21 (kind=forward_replay).
- Backtest (`--backtest`): same rules over the last ~90 daily bars per coin, levels rebuilt from data available on
  each day; ladders re-anchor on: close crossing a rung/W-M level, |move| > 15% from anchor, or anchor age > 14d.
  IN-SAMPLE, daily bars only (intrabar order unknown), level/pivot code tuned on this same period, survivorship
  (current watchlist). Kept separate from the forward ledger (starts 2026-10-21).
